sentences.en: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen. My name is Art Benjamin, and I am a "mathemagician."
sentences.zh: 早上好，女士们先生们。我的名字是阿特·本杰明，我是一名“数学魔术师”。

sentences.en: What that means is, I combine my loves of math and magic to do something I call "mathemagics."
sentences.zh: 这意味着，我将我对数学和魔法的热爱结​​合起来，做一些我称之为“数学魔法”的事情。

sentences.en: But before I get started, I have a quick question for the audience.
sentences.zh: 但在开始之前，我有一个简短的问题要问观众。

sentences.en: By any chance, did anyone happen to bring with them this morning a calculator?
sentences.zh: 碰巧，今天早上有人碰巧带了计算器吗？

sentences.en: Seriously, if you have a calculator with you, raise your hand.
sentences.zh: 说真的，如果你有计算器，请举手。

sentences.en: Raise your hand. Did your hand go up? Now bring it out, bring it out. Anybody else?
sentences.zh: 举起你的手。你的手举起来了吗？现在拿出来，拿出来。还有其他人吗？

sentences.en: I see, I see one way in the back. You sir, that's three.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，我看到后面有一条路。先生，这是三个。

sentences.en: And anybody on this side here? OK, over there on the aisle.
sentences.zh: 这边有人吗？好的，在过道那边。

sentences.en: Would the four of you please bring out your calculators, then join me up on stage.
sentences.zh: 请你们四位拿出计算器，然后和我一起上台。

sentences.en: Let's give them a nice round of applause.
sentences.zh: 让我们给他们热烈的掌声。

sentences.en: (Applause) That's right. Now, since I haven't had the chance to work with these calculators, I need to make sure that they are all working properly.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）是的。现在，由于我还没有机会使用这些计算器，所以我需要确保它们都正常工作。

sentences.en: Would somebody get us started by giving us a two-digit number, please?
sentences.zh: 有人可以给我们一个两位数的号码来帮助我们开始吗？

sentences.en: How about a two-digit number? Audience: 22.
sentences.zh: 两位数怎么样？观众：22。

sentences.en: AB: 22. And another two-digit number, sir?
sentences.zh: AB：22。还有另一个两位数吗，先生？

sentences.en: Audience: 47. AB: Multiply 22 times 47, make sure you get 1,034, or the calculators are not working.
sentences.zh: 观众：47。AB：22 乘以 47，确保得到 1,034，否则计算器无法工作。

sentences.en: Do all of you get 1,034? Volunteer: No.
sentences.zh: 你们都拿到1034了吗？志愿者：没有。

sentences.en: AB: 594. Let's give three of them a nice round of applause there.
sentences.zh: AB：594。让我们向他们三位热烈鼓掌。

sentences.en: (Applause) Would you like to try a more standard calculator, just in case?
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）为了以防万一，你想尝试一下更标准的计算器吗？

sentences.en: OK, great. What I'm going to try and do then -- I notice it took some of you a little bit of time to get your answer.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。接下来我要尝试做的事情——我注意到你们中的一些人花了一点时间才得到答案。

sentences.en: That's OK. I'll give you a shortcut for multiplying even faster on the calculator.
sentences.zh: 没关系。我将为您提供在计算器上更快地进行乘法的快捷方式。

sentences.en: There is something called the square of a number, which most of you know is taking a number and multiplying it by itself.
sentences.zh: 有一种叫做数字平方的东西，大多数人都知道它是将一个数字与它本身相乘。

sentences.en: For instance, five squared would be? Audience: 25.
sentences.zh: 例如，五的平方是？观众：25。

sentences.en: AB: 25. The way we can square on most calculators -- let me demonstrate with this one -- is by taking the number, such as five, hitting "times" and then "equals," and on most calculators that will give you the square.
sentences.zh: AB：25。我们在大多数计算器上计算平方的方法（让我用这个计算器来演示）是通过取数字（例如五），点击“乘”，然后点击“等于”，并且在大多数计算器上都会给出平方。

sentences.en: On some of these ancient RPN calculators, you've got an "x squared" button on it, will allow you to do the calculation even faster.
sentences.zh: 在一些古老的 RPN 计算器上，你有一个“x 平方”按钮，可以让你更快地进行计算。

sentences.en: What I'm going to try and do now is to square, in my head, four two-digit numbers faster than they can do on their calculators, even using the shortcut method.
sentences.zh: 我现在要尝试做的是在我的脑海中计算四个两位数的平方，速度比他们在计算器上的速度更快，即使使用快捷方法也是如此。

sentences.en: What I'll use is the second row this time, and I'll get four of you to each yell out a two-digit number, and if you would square the first number, and if you would square the second, the third and the fourth, I will try and race you to the answer. OK?
sentences.zh: 这次我要用第二排,我叫你们四位 每人喊一个二位数的号码, 如果你把第一个数字平开, 如果你把第二个、第三个和第四个平开, 我会试着和你比对一下答案。好吗?

sentences.en: So quickly, a two-digit number please. Audience: 37.
sentences.zh: 这么快,两位数,观众:37。

sentences.en: Arthur Benjamin: 37 squared, OK. Audience: 23.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟・本杰明:37平方,好。观众:23。

sentences.en: AB: 23 squared, OK. Audience: 59. AB: 59 squared, OK, and finally?
sentences.zh: AB:23平方,OK。观众:59AB:59平方,OK,最后?

sentences.en: Audience: 93. AB: 93 squared. Would you call out your answers, please?
sentences.zh: 观众:93 AB:93 方形。请说出答案好吗?

sentences.en: Volunteer: 1369. AB: 1369. Volunteer: 529. AB: 529.
Volunteer: 3481. AB: 3481. Volunteer: 8649.
sentences.zh: 志愿人员:3481人,AB:3481人,志愿人员:8649人。

sentences.en: AB: Thank you very much. (Applause) Let me try to take this one step further.
sentences.zh: AB:非常感谢。 (掌声)让我再进一步一点。

sentences.en: I'm going to try to square some three-digit numbers this time.
sentences.zh: 这次我会试着对准三个数字

sentences.en: I won't even write these down -- I'll just call them out as they're called out to me.
sentences.zh: 我什至不会写下来-- 我会叫他们出来,因为他们被叫出来给我。

sentences.en: Anyone I point to, call out a three-digit number.
sentences.zh: 任何我指的, 喊出一个3位数的号码。

sentences.en: Anyone on our panel, verify the answer. Just give some indication if it's right.
sentences.zh: 任何在我们的板上, 核实答案, 只要给出一些指示, 如果它是正确的。

sentences.en: A three-digit number, sir, yes? Audience: 987.
sentences.zh: 3位数的号码,长官,是的?

sentences.en: AB: 987 squared is 974,169. (Laughter) AB: Yes? Good.
Another three-digit -- (Applause) -- another three-digit number, sir?
sentences.zh: 又一个三位数 -- (掌声) -- 又一个三位数,先生?

sentences.en: Audience: 457. AB: 457 squared is 205,849.
205,849? AB: Yes? OK, another, another three-digit number, sir?
sentences.zh: 205,849?AB:是的。OK,另一个, 3位数的号码,先生?

sentences.en: Audience: 321. AB: 321 is 103,041.
Yes? One more three-digit number please.
sentences.zh: 请再加一个三位数

sentences.en: Audience: Oh, 722. AB: 722 is 500, that's a harder one.
sentences.zh: 观众:哦,722。AB:722是500,这是更难的。

sentences.en: Is that 513,284? Volunteer: Yes. AB: Yes? Oh, one more, one more three-digit number please.
sentences.zh: 513,284吗?自愿者:是的。AB:是的?请再加一个3位数。

sentences.en: Audience: 162. 162 squared is 26,244. Volunteer: Yes.
Thank you very much. (Applause) (Applause ends) Let me try to take this one step further.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 (掌声) (掌声) (掌声结束)让我再往前走一步。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'm going to try to square a four-digit number this time.
sentences.zh: 这次我要尝试平方一个四位数的号码

sentences.en: You can all take your time on this; I will not beat you to the answer on this one, but I will try to get the answer right.
sentences.zh: 你们可以花时间讨论这个问题;我不会赢你们关于这一个问题的答案,但我会尽力得到正确的答案。

sentences.en: To make this a little bit more random, let's take the fourth row this time, let's say, one, two, three, four.
sentences.zh: 为了让这更随机一些, 让我们采取第四排的这一次,让我们说,一,二,三,四。

sentences.en: If each of you would call out a single digit between zero and nine, that will be the four-digit number that I'll square.
sentences.zh: 如果你们每个人都在零和九之间喊一个数字, 那就是我所要平方的四位数。

sentences.en: Nine. Seven. Five. Eight. 9,758, this will take me a little bit of time, so bear with me.
sentences.zh: 九,七,五,八,九,七,八 这需要我一点时间,所以忍耐我。

sentences.en: 95 million -- (Sighs) 218,564? Volunteer: Yes!
AB: Thank you very much. (Applause) (Applause ends) Now, I would attempt to square a five-digit number --
sentences.zh: AB:非常感谢。 (掌声) (掌声) (掌声结束) 现在,我想把一个五位数的号码平方 --

sentences.en: and I can -- but unfortunately, most calculators cannot.
sentences.zh: 我可以,但不幸的是,大多数计算器都不行。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Eight-digit capacity -- don't you hate that?
sentences.zh: (笑声) 八位数的能力--你不讨厌吗?

sentences.en: So, since we've reached the limits of our calculators -- what's that?
sentences.zh: 所以,既然我们已经到了计算器的极限-- 那是什么?

sentences.en: Does yours go higher? Volunteer: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你的车能再高一点吗?

sentences.en: AB: Oh, yours does? Volunteer: I can probably do it. AB: I'll talk to you later.
sentences.zh: 阿瑟:哦,你的吗?志愿者:我可能做得到。阿瑟:我稍后再跟你谈。

sentences.en: In the meanwhile, let me conclude the first part of my show by doing something a little trickier.
sentences.zh: 与此同时,让我做一些更诡计的事情来结束我节目的第一部分。

sentences.en: Let's take the largest number on the board here, 8649.
sentences.zh: 8649号机上最大的号码

sentences.en: Would you each enter that on your calculator?
sentences.zh: 你们每个人会在计算器上输入吗?

sentences.en: And instead of squaring it this time, I want you to take that number and multiply it by any three-digit number that you want, but don't tell me what you're multiplying by -- just multiply it by any random three-digit number.
sentences.zh: 这一次,我要你用这个数字 乘以任何三位数,但别告诉我你正在乘以什么-- 随便乘以任何三位数。

sentences.en: So you should have as an answer either a six-digit or probably a seven-digit number.
sentences.zh: 所以,你应该有一个答案 要么是六位数 要么可能是七位数。

sentences.en: How many digits do you have, six or seven?
sentences.zh: 你有几位数,六或七位数?

sentences.en: Seven, and yours? Seven? And, uncertain.
sentences.zh: 7个,还有你的?

sentences.en: Seven. Is there any possible way that I could know what seven-digit numbers you have?
sentences.zh: 七,有没有办法让我知道你的7位数?

sentences.en: Say "No." (Laughter) Good, then I shall attempt the impossible -- or at least the improbable.
sentences.zh: 说:不。好。然后,我将尝试不可能的,或至少是不可能的。

sentences.en: What I'd like each of you to do is to call out for me any six of your seven digits, any six of them, in any order you'd like.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们每个人能为我 呼唤你们7位数中的6位数, 任何6位数, 任何顺序。

sentences.en: (Laughter) One digit at a time, I shall try and determine the digit you've left out.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 一位数一次,我会试着确定 你遗漏的数字。

sentences.en: Starting with your seven-digit number, call out any six of them please.
sentences.zh: 从你的7位数开始,请说出其中的6位数

sentences.en: Volunteer: 1, 9, 7, 0, 4, 2. AB: Did you leave out the number 6?
Good, OK, that's one. You have a seven-digit number, call out any six of them please.
sentences.zh: 好,好,这是1个,你有7位数的号码,请说出其中6位数

sentences.en: Volunteer: 4, 8, 7, 5. I think I only heard five numbers. I -- wait -- 44875 -- did you leave out the number 6?
sentences.zh: 志愿者:4,8,7,5,我想我只听到5个数字。我,等等,44875,你把6号排除在外了吗?

sentences.en: Same as she did, OK. You've got a seven-digit number -- call out any six of them loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 跟她一样,好吧,你有7位数的号码, 大声和清楚地叫出其中的6位。

sentences.en: Volunteer: 0, 7, 9, 0, 4, 4. I think you left out the number 3?
sentences.zh: 志愿者: 0,7,9,0,4,4,我认为你漏掉了3号?

sentences.en: AB: That's three. The odds of me getting all four of these right by random guessing would be one in 10,000: 10 to the fourth power.
sentences.zh: AB:这是三点。我通过随机猜想得到所有四个正确的概率是万分之一:十分之一到第四位。

sentences.en: OK, any six of them. (Laughter) Really scramble them up this time, please.
sentences.zh: 好吧,任何6个。 (笑声)这次真的把他们弄乱了。

sentences.en: Volunteer: 2, 6, 3, 9, 7, 2. Did you leave out the number 7?
And let's give all four of these people a nice round of applause.
sentences.zh: 让我们给这四个人一个热烈的掌声

sentences.en: Thank you very much. (Applause) (Applause ends) For my next number -- (Laughter)
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 (掌声) (掌声) (掌声结束) 下一个号码 -- (笑声)

sentences.en: while I mentally recharge my batteries, I have one more question for the audience.
sentences.zh: 当我在精神上充电的时候 我还有一个问题要问观众

sentences.en: By any chance, does anybody here happen to know the day of the week that they were born on?
sentences.zh: 有没有人碰巧知道 他们出生的那个星期的哪天?

sentences.en: If you think you know your birth day, raise your hand.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为你知道你的出生日, 举手。

sentences.en: Let's see, starting with -- let's start with a gentleman first.
sentences.zh: 让我们先从绅士开始。

sentences.en: What year was it, first of all? That's why I pick a gentleman first.
sentences.zh: 那年是哪一年?

sentences.en: Audience: 1953. 1953, and the month? November what?
23rd -- was that a Monday? Audience: Yes.
sentences.zh: 第23次 - 那是星期一吗?观众:是的。

sentences.en: Good. Somebody else? I haven't seen any women's hands up.
sentences.zh: 很好,还有别人吗?

sentences.en: OK, how about you, what year? 1949, and the month?
sentences.zh: 好吧,你怎么样,哪一年?

sentences.en: October what? Fifth -- was that a Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 10月什么 第五次 那是星期三吗

sentences.en: Yes! I'll go way to the back right now, how about you?
sentences.zh: 对,我马上到后面去,你呢?

sentences.en: Yell it out, what year? Audience: 1959. 1959, OK -- and the month?
sentences.zh: 大声喊,哪一年?观众:1959年,1959年,好,这个月?

sentences.en: Audience: February. February what? Sixth -- was that a Friday? Audience: Yes.
sentences.zh: 观众:2月,2月什么?第六,是星期五吗?观众:是的。

sentences.en: Good, how about the person behind her? Call out, what year was it?
sentences.zh: 很好,她后面的人怎么样?

sentences.en: Audience: 1947. AB: 1947, and the month?
sentences.zh: 观众:1947年。AB:1947年,这个月?

sentences.en: Audience: May. AB: May what? Seventh -- would that be a Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 观众:5月。AB:5月什么?第七,那会是星期三吗?

sentences.en: Audience: Yes. AB: Thank you very much. (Applause) Anybody here who'd like to know the day of the week they were born?
sentences.zh: 观众:是的。AB:非常感谢。 (掌声)这里有人想知道他们出生的那一天吗?

sentences.en: We can do it that way. Of course, I could just make up an answer and you wouldn't know, so I come prepared for that.
sentences.zh: 当然,我可以做一个答案,你不知道,所以我来了准备。

sentences.en: I brought with me a book of calendars. It goes as far back into the past as 1800, because you never know.
sentences.zh: 我带了一本日历书 追溯到1800年前 因为你永远不知道

sentences.en: (Laughter) I didn't mean to look at you, sir -- you were just sitting there.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要看你的 长官 你只是坐在那里

sentences.en: (Laughter) Anyway, Chris, you can help me out here, if you wouldn't mind.
sentences.zh: 总之 克里斯 如果你不介意的话 你可以帮我

sentences.en: This is a book of calendars. Who wanted to know their birth day?
sentences.zh: 这是一本日历书 谁想知道他们的出生日?

sentences.en: What year was it, first of all? Audience: 1966.
sentences.zh: 这是哪一年,首先?观众:1966年。

sentences.en: 66 -- turn to the calendar with 1966. And what month?
sentences.zh: 66 - 转到1966年的日历。

sentences.en: Audience: April. AB: April what? Audience: 17th.
sentences.zh: 观众:4月。AB:4月什么?观众:17。

sentences.en: I believe that was a Sunday. Can you confirm, Chris?
sentences.zh: 我相信那是星期天 你能确认吗 克里斯?

sentences.en: Chris Anderson: Yes. AB: I'll tell you what, Chris: as long as you have that book in front of you, do me a favor, turn to a year outside of the 1900s, either into the 1800s or way into the 2000s -- that'll be a much greater challenge for me.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·安德森:是的。阿瑟:我告诉你,克里斯:只要你面前有那本书, 帮我一个忙, 转到1900年代以外的一年, 要么进入1800年代,要么进入2000年代, 这对我来说将是一个更大的挑战。

sentences.en: AB: What year would you like? CA: 1824. AB: 1824, OK.
sentences.zh: AB:你喜欢哪一年?CA:1824年。AB:1824年,好吧。

sentences.en: AB: And what month? CA: June. AB: June what? CA: Sixth.
sentences.zh: AB:哪个月?CA:六月。AB:六月?CA:六月。

sentences.en: AB: Was that a Sunday? CA: It was. AB: And it was cloudy.
sentences.zh: AB:是星期天吗?CA:是的。AB:是阴云。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Good, thank you very much. (Applause) (Applause ends) But I'd like to wrap things up now by alluding to something from earlier in the presentation.
sentences.zh: 很好,非常感谢。 (掌声) (掌声结束) 但我现在想总结一下事情 通过在演示文稿的早期

sentences.en: There was a gentleman up here who had a 10-digit calculator.
sentences.zh: 上面有个绅士 有个10位数的计算器

sentences.en: Where is he, would you stand up, 10-digit guy?
sentences.zh: 他在哪里,你能站起来吗,10位数的家伙?

sentences.en: OK, stand up for me just for a second, so I can see where you are.
sentences.zh: 好,站出来等我一下 这样我就能看见你在哪里了

sentences.en: You have a 10-digit calculator, sir, as well?
sentences.zh: 你有10位数的计算器吗,先生?

sentences.en: OK, what I'm going to try and do, is to square in my head a five-digit number requiring a 10-digit calculator.
sentences.zh: 好吧,我要做的是 在我的脑海里平方 一个5位数的号码 需要一个10位数的计算器。

sentences.en: But to make my job more interesting for you, as well as for me, I'm going to do this problem thinking out loud.
sentences.zh: 但是为了让你和我的工作更有趣 我要大声地思考这个问题

sentences.en: So you can actually, honestly hear what's going on in my mind while I do a calculation of this size.
sentences.zh: 所以,你实际上可以,说实话, 听听我在想什么 当我做一个计算 这个大小。

sentences.en: Now, I have to apologize to our magician friend Lennart Green.
sentences.zh: 我得向我们的魔术师朋友伦纳特·格林道歉

sentences.en: I know as a magician we're not supposed to reveal our secrets, but I'm not too afraid that people are going to start doing my show next week, so -- I think we're OK.
sentences.zh: 我知道作为一个魔术师,我们不应该透露我们的秘密, 但我并不担心人们 下周会开始我的节目,所以——我想我们没事。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) So, let's see, let's take a different row of people, starting with you.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 所以,让我们来看看, 让我们换一排人,从你开始。

sentences.en: I'll get five digits: one, two, three, four.
sentences.zh: 我会得到五个数字: 一,二,三,四。

sentences.en: Oh, I did this row already. Let's do the row before you, starting with you: one, two, three, four, five.
sentences.zh: 哦,我已经排过这排了。让我们在你之前排一次,从你开始:一,二,三,四,五。

sentences.en: Call out a single digit -- that will be the five-digit number that I will try to square, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 喊出一个数字——这将是我要尝试平方的五位数，继续。

sentences.en: Five. Seven. Six. Eight. Three. 57,683 -- squared.
Yuck. Let me explain to you how I'm going to attempt this problem.
sentences.zh: 恶心。让我向你解释一下我将如何尝试这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm going to break the problem down into three parts.
sentences.zh: 我将把问题分成三个部分。

sentences.en: I'll do 57,000 squared, plus 683 squared, plus 57,000 times 683 times two.
sentences.zh: 我会做 57,000 的平方，加上 683 的平方，加上 57,000 乘以 683 乘以 2。

sentences.en: Add all those numbers together, and with any luck, arrive at the answer.
sentences.zh: 将所有这些数字加在一起，如果运气好的话，就能得出答案。

sentences.en: Now, let me recap. (Laughter) Thank you.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我回顾一下。 （笑声）谢谢。

sentences.en: (Laughter) While I explain something else -- (Laughter) -- I know, that you can use, right?
sentences.zh: （笑声）当我解释其他东西时——（笑声）——我知道，你可以使用，对吧？

sentences.en: (Laughter) While I do these calculations, you might hear certain words, as opposed to numbers, creep into the calculation.
sentences.zh: （笑声）当我进行这些计算时，您可能会听到某些单词（而不是数字）渗透到计算中。

sentences.en: Let me explain what that is. This is a phonetic code, a mnemonic device that I use, that allows me to convert numbers into words.
sentences.zh: 让我解释一下那是什么。这是一个语音代码，是我使用的助记符，可以让我将数字转换为单词。

sentences.en: I store them as words, and later on retrieve them as numbers.
sentences.zh: 我将它们存储为单词，然后将它们作为数字检索。

sentences.en: I know it sounds complicated; it's not. I don't want you to think you're seeing something out of "Rain Man."
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来很复杂；它不是。我不想让你认为你从《雨人》中看到了一些东西。

sentences.en: (Laughter) There's definitely a method to my madness -- definitely, definitely.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我的疯狂肯定有办法——绝对，绝对。

sentences.en: Sorry. (Laughter) If you want to talk to me about ADHD afterwards, you can talk to me then.
sentences.zh: 对不起。 （笑声）如果之后你想和我谈谈多动症的话，你可以到时候跟我说。

sentences.en: By the way, one last instruction, for my judges with the calculators -- you know who you are -- there is at least a 50 percent chance that I will make a mistake here.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，最后一个指示，是给我的计算器评委们的——你们知道你们是谁——我在这里至少有 50% 的可能性会犯错误。

sentences.en: If I do, don't tell me what the mistake is; just say, "you're close," or something like that, and I'll try and figure out the answer -- which could be pretty entertaining in itself.
sentences.zh: 如果我这样做了，请不要告诉我错误是什么；只要说，“你已经很接近了”，或者类似的话，我会尝试找出答案——这本身就很有趣。

sentences.en: If, however, I am right, whatever you do, don't keep it to yourself, OK?
sentences.zh: 然而，如果我是对的，无论你做什么，都不要自己保密，好吗？

sentences.en: (Laughter) Make sure everybody knows that I got the answer right, because this is my big finish, OK.
sentences.zh: （笑声）确保每个人都知道我的答案是正确的，因为这是我的大结局，好吧。

sentences.en: So, without any more stalling, here we go.
sentences.zh: 所以，不再拖延，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: I'll start the problem in the middle, with 57 times 683.
sentences.zh: 我将从中间开始解决这个问题，即 57 乘以 683。

sentences.en: 38,931; double that to get 77,862. 77,862 becomes cookie fission, cookie fission is 77,822.
sentences.zh: 38,931；翻倍得到 77,862。 77,862变成cookie裂变，cookie裂变是77,822。

sentences.en: That seems right, I'll go on. Cookie fission, OK.
sentences.zh: 看来是这样，我继续。饼干裂变，好吧。

sentences.en: Next, I do 57 squared, which is 3,249, so I can say, three billion.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我做 57 的平方，即 3,249，所以我可以说，三十亿。

sentences.en: Take the 249, add that to cookie, 249, oops, but I see a carry coming -- 249 -- add that to cookie, 250 plus 77, is 327 million --
sentences.zh: 取 249，将其添加到 cookie，249，哎呀，但我看到一个进位即将到来 - 249 - 将其添加到 cookie，250 加 77，是 3.27 亿 -

sentences.en: fission, OK, finally, we do 683 squared, that's 700 times 666, plus 17 squared is 466,489, rev up if I need it, rev up, take the 466, add that to fission, to get,
sentences.zh: 裂变,OK,最后,我们做683平方, 这是700乘666,加17平方是466,489, 如果我需要的话, 转动,采取466,加上裂变, 获得,

sentences.en: oh gee -- 328,489. Audience: Yeah! AB: Good.
sentences.zh: 哦,天哪,328,489 观众:是的!AB:很好。

sentences.en: Thank you very much. (Applause) I hope you enjoyed mathemagics.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 (掌声) 我希望你喜欢 mathemagics。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
